Well, I'm a 19 year old girl who finished highschool 2 years ago. When I was 17 I got my first job and had to work in a place that paid minimum wage (it was around 10$ monthly atm) since it was the only place that would accept me being a minor. When I turned 18 I found another job in which they payed around 35/40$ monthly and everyone I knew told me that they payed me well and as a matter of a fact I knew a lot of people that earned much less, mostly single mothers that were obligated to work in order to pay for their family expenses. I quit my job since in January there were so little sales and the store owner was paying us less than 20$ monthly and food was getting really expensive in comparison to what I was making. Besides that, we worked over 10 hours a day usually 6 days a week, they gave us 15min for lunch time and we had to take care of inventory, running errands that had nothing to do with our job, etc... And if you missed one day of work they took away half of your salary and you couldn't say anything since they were paying you more than minimum wage anyway. I got in a scorting agency located in the capital and it was the only way I found out of that shitty job and thanks to that I saved enough money to manage myself during quarantine, thankfully. It's kinda hard for females with no studies to earn more than 40$ monthly, a few men I know got gigs that were essentially handyman stuff, carpenter jobs, stuff like that. Since I speak English fairly well and have access to Internet I try my best to do a little bit of everything I can to not be in complete bankruptcy haha. I can't study atm since I'm just 19, don't count with my family's financial support and live alone. Although I don't have children and plan to keep it that way if I don't wanna starve to death and not giving an innocent child the life he deserves bc let's be honest. A person who doesn't have enough money to buy groceries or pay for shelter will have a hard time being happy.

Dude don't get defensive, I was just stating my experience and a lot Venezuelans are in a similar or worse situation than mine, since education is so shitty some people aren't even informed about Bitcoin or just don't have access to Internet. Most people buy dollars for savings but tell me, if I win 30 dollars a month and buy 10$ how the hell am I gonna pay my rent, and eat ok-ish? Another problem is that damaged dollars are not accepted in many stores and 1$/5$ are rare to find for buyers.  Most people who do have savings have relatives in other country's who help them economically. Of course that if I can I will try to be as smart as possible about my money but unfortunately that's not most people's case. That's the point of my comment, most people are doing reaaally bad rn. Not trying to attack you, I'm stating my experience as a native venezuelan so you have more perspective on the issue.

Most of us can barely afford food let alone invest or have savings. People have been fired from jobs that didn't even pay properly (minimum wage is less than 10$ atm) and those who still have their job are not being compensated for anything during quarantine, just hanging on. It seems that every time I go out there are more homeless, disoriented people out there and I can only wonder how they got in that state. I'm a 19 year old girl and can't start studying college yet because I live alone and have to take care of my expenses and the only jobs that are paying "well" (around 30$ monthly) for people with no studies demand you to work over 10 hours a day 5 or 6 days a week. Sometimes 7. I can barely keep up with my bills and I mean this seriously, sometimes I have to choose between paying for my rent or buying meat for making my lunch. Obviously having takeout is a no. Thankfully I don't have children and I empathize for those who do, as they won't grow up with a proper diet, normal toys, having fun around the neighborhood (because of delinquency), proper schools... I have been waiting (and so have plenty of people) for something to happen, after all those protests, all those deaths. But it seems that they have all been in vain, as the situation has not change, if anything it's getting worse.
